job.title: Synthetic: extend a Next.js admin dashboard

listing.text: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE LISTING. We run an internal Next.js admin dashboard backed by PostgreSQL and need a senior engineer to add role-based reporting pages, fix slow queries, and write tests. Fixed budget between 3000 and 5000 USD. Payment verified, 18 previous hires.

analysis.client_problem: The internal team cannot keep up with reporting requests.
analysis.recommended_positioning: Senior engineer who can extend an existing codebase safely.
analysis.analysis_summary: Solid fit with a reliable client and moderate competition.

base_version.body: Synthetic previous draft. Your team needs reporting pages without slowing down the rest of the roadmap. I have extended several Next.js and PostgreSQL dashboards in production and can start with the slowest queries before adding the new role-based pages.

instructions: Shorter opening, and mention query performance first.
